section_completion_log.section_name: Quality and efficiency of the implementation

revision_actions.description: Resolve the sequencing tension by stating that a provisional stress-target and validation protocol are fixed and documented before the month-3 freeze (with D1.1/D1.2 as their formalisation), or adjust the D1.1/D1.2 due months so the defining protocol and harmonised base precede D2.1.
revision_actions.reason: The current draft leaves D2.1 at month 3 and D1.1/D1.2 at month 14 unchanged and adds no explicit reconciliation that a provisional target/protocol is fixed pre-freeze with D1.1/D1.2 as later formalisations; closing the internal-plausibility gap requires new prose in sub-section 1.1/1.2, and Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision. Deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Add an explicit statement of the new, citable scientific knowledge the validation framework yields and what is currently not achievable, so the beyond-the-state-of-the-art claim rests on a demonstrable advance rather than process rigour alone.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 1.1 still frames the advance primarily as a validation framework and process discipline and does not add a sharpened statement of concrete new citable scientific knowledge or of what is currently not achievable; supplying it requires new prose, and Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision. Deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Evidence that the modelling/EO training capacity at ELTE is secured (imminent associated-partner and co-supervision confirmations) and describe the host-side continuity safeguard for the central training strand if the associated-partner arrangement changes.
revision_actions.reason: The draft still declares the ELTE associated-partner participation, the Hollós modelling role and Jung co-supervision as working assumptions pending written confirmation, and adds no evidence of imminent confirmation letters nor a host-side continuity safeguard. Evidence of imminent confirmations is a project fact absent from Tier 3 (§13.3), and the continuity-safeguard narrative requires new prose that Phase 8f does not automate. Deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Introduce conditional, method-anchored expected-effect ranges (detection lead-time, water-productivity improvement envelopes the design is powered to show) so the project's own magnitude is quantified as a defensible expectation, not only literature context.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 2.3 continues to decline any project-specific quantified target, offering only bounded literature ranges (approx. 8-30%) and a list of measured quantities; it adds no conditional method-anchored expected-effect envelope. Introducing such ranges requires new prose, and Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision. Deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Provide a month-by-month effort-loading view at the WP1/WP3/WP4 overlap and show how partner in-kind support offloads the fellow, to demonstrate the single-researcher concurrency is feasible.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 3.1 gives per-WP effort totals (WP1 9.0, WP3 6.6, WP4 6.0 PM) and partner in-kind PM but no month-by-month effort-loading profile at the peak WP1/WP3/WP4 overlap. Adding a month-resolved loading view is new content, and Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision. Deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Reassign WP3 scientific leadership to the fellow/beneficiary with the farmer site as a hosting environment, and cite the T3.1 access agreement and contingency ladder as the mitigating controls.
revision_actions.reason: The draft still designates WP3 lead as 'the independent commercial-farmer validation site'; it cites T3.1 and the contingency ladder but does not perform the requested leadership reassignment to the fellow/beneficiary. Reassigning WP-lead attribution requires rewritten prose in sub-section 3.1, and Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision. Deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Foreground concrete modelling/EO artefacts (existing DrR functionality, datasets, tool outputs) to evidence hands-on capability while keeping the honest competence-gap framing.
Anchor the employability breadth in one or two concrete post-fellowship trajectories and cite the specific career KPI used to measure the career outcome.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 2.1 still presents employability as a broad spread of destinations and references 'the project's own career KPI' only generically; it does not anchor one or two concrete post-fellowship trajectories nor name/specify the career KPI. Concretising trajectories and specifying the KPI requires new prose, and Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision. Deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Add a small set of measurable dissemination/uptake indicators (audiences reached, farmer participants, MVP evaluation users) tied to named channels, proportionate to a single-researcher action.
revision_actions.reason: Sub-section 2.2 defines dissemination by output counts (two papers, one demonstration and one article per year) and adds no measurable audience-reach or uptake indicators (audiences reached, farmer participants, MVP evaluation users). Adding such indicators requires new prose, and Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision. Deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Quantify the near-term reachable segment (e.g. processing-tomato area in the target countries) alongside the EU-domain figure so the scale claim is graduated from what the action touches to the wider potential.
Renumber the work packages consecutively or add a one-line note that the former WP2 was merged into WP1, so the numbering gap is not read as an omission.
revision_actions.reason: The implementation section prose lists WP1, WP3, WP4, WP5 with no in-section note explaining the missing WP2; the WP2-merged-into-WP1 note exists only in the assembled-draft consistency log (CC-02), not in the evaluator-facing section text. Renumbering or inserting an explanatory note requires prose change in sub-section 3.1, and Phase 8f performs no automated prose revision. Deferred to an operator-directed revision cycle.

revision_actions.description: Reinforce participating-organisation capacity by evidencing the operational competence that substitutes for a research track record and confirming that PIC registration and host Part A legal-status verification are in hand before submission.
